integrity: The all-state theorem is proved analytically. The bundled finite computation only checks derived formulas and representative rotation inequalities and is not used to infer the universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The polar-factor comparison is proved for qubits when the original worst-case normalized postselection disturbance is strictly below 1/2. It does not settle higher dimensions or the full large-disturbance regime.
title: Polar-factor gentleness for qubit measurements below the one-half disturbance threshold
